title: Fall Foliage & Real Estate in Boone NC | October 2026
excerpt: October in the High Country is one of the most spectacular times of year — and one of the most underrated windows to buy mountain property NC has to offer. Local REALTOR Andrew Plyler breaks down what leaf season means for buyers and sellers in Boone this fall.
